items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Who was that that once said--I think Adam Clayton Powell, or someone, said there's been lots of night time integration for many, many years.

ctx.x: Yes, the color line; you didn't cross it too much, not openly anyway.
Who was that that once said--I think Adam Clayton Powell, or someone, said
there's been lots of night time integration for many, many years. I guess that was a little unusual in those days.
